annotations.title: Send details and get initial quotes

description:
Get estimated auto insurance rates (RC1 quotes) for the user, from the carriers they can buy from online on
The Zebra.

Call zebra_start_session first and pass its quote_handle. Usually takes about 30 seconds: wait for the result
rather than calling again or starting a new session. On UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE, retry once with the same quote_handle.

A carrier may quote higher or lower coverage than requested; each quote's coverage_differences lists what differs.
When you show a quote with differences, tell the user what they are: the price is for the quoted coverage, not the
requested one.

Pass the quote_id of the quote the user picks to zebra_get_rate_action to learn how to continue. Calling this again
for the same session re-rates the quote with the new details and replaces the earlier quotes, so their quote_ids
stop working. Nothing is bought and no policy changes: to compare against the earlier details, call again with
them. Quotes are live, so prices may differ from before; don't tell the user the earlier prices still hold.
Failures return a JSON error with a code, whether retrying may help, and any problems with specific user_responses
fields. NO_QUOTES means no carrier has a quote the user can buy online on The Zebra, and its reason says why.
It comes with an agency_phone: tell the user why in plain words and give them agency_phone and the agency
hours, where a licensed agent can help them find coverage. Don't call again with the same details.

coverage_package.description: The coverages to price the quotes at. Send it only when the user wants specific coverage or wants to match their current policy; otherwise leave it out, and quotes use The Zebra's recommended coverage for the user. Don't ask about coverage just to fill this in. Amounts are in dollars, sent as plain numbers (100000, not $100,000). Users give liability as three numbers in thousands: 100/300/100 means bodily_injury_per_person 100000, bodily_injury_per_accident 300000 and property_damage 100000. 'Full coverage' or a deductible means comprehensive and collision on that vehicle; a deductible like $1,000 sets both unless the user gives them separately. When the user brings up coverage, confirm what they left out before calling: which vehicles get comprehensive and collision, and whether uninsured motorist coverage should match their bodily injury limits. If the call fails with INVALID_ARGUMENTS, each detail names a missing or conflicting coverage and the values the state offers; ask the user to choose rather than picking for them.

quote_handle.description: The quote_handle that zebra_start_session returned. It expires 24 hours after zebra_start_session; if a tool reports it unknown or expired, start a new session.

drivers.description: Drivers on the policy. The first is the primary driver (the user). Depending on other answers, it also needs `education` (unless `state` is MA), `credit_score` (unless `state` is HI or CA or MA) and `insured_length` (only when `auto.coverage_history.currently_insured` is 1; leave it out when it is 0).

name: zebra_get_rc1_rates

quotes.description: Every quote the user can buy online on The Zebra. Carriers that can't be bought online here are left out.

carrier_name.description: The insurance carrier offering the quote.

coverage_differences.description: Where this quote's coverage differs from what was requested; empty when it matches.

coverage.description: The coverage that differs: bodily_injury_per_person, bodily_injury_per_accident, property_damage, personal_injury_limit_per_person (PIP), or a vehicle's comprehensive or collision deductible.

quoted.description: What the quote includes, in dollars, or "Infinity" for no limit. Null when not included.

requested.description: What was requested, in dollars, or "Infinity" for no limit. Null when not requested.

vehicle_label.description: The vehicle a deductible applies to, as year make model. Null for policy-wide coverages.

down_payment.description: Due when the policy is bought, in dollars.

bodily_injury_per_accident.description: The maximum the policy pays for all injuries in one accident, in dollars.

bodily_injury_per_person.description: The maximum the policy pays for one person's injuries in an accident, in dollars.

property_damage.description: The maximum the policy pays for other people's property in an accident, in dollars.

monthly_price.description: The estimated price per month for the policy term, in dollars. The final price is set when the user buys on The Zebra.

policy_term_months.description: How long the policy lasts, in months.

quote_id.description: Pass this to zebra_get_rate_action when the user picks this quote. An internal ID, not one to show the user.

total_premium.description: The estimated price for the whole policy term on the carrier's recommended pay plan, in dollars. Null when the carrier doesn't give it.

collision_deductible.description: What the user pays first on a collision claim, in dollars.

comprehensive_deductible.description: What the user pays first on a comprehensive claim (theft, weather, etc.), in dollars.

vehicle_label.description: The vehicle these deductibles apply to, as year make model.

vehicles.description: The catalog vehicle each of the user's vehicles was matched to, in request order.

matched_by.description: How the vehicle was found in the catalog: vin (by its VIN), style (the submodel named a style), trim (the submodel named a trim, and its lowest-priced style was used) or default_style (the submodel matched nothing, so the model's lowest-priced style was used). Confirm the vehicle with the user when it's default_style, or when you sent a VIN and it isn't vin: the catalog didn't know the VIN, so it wasn't used.

vehicle.description: Year, make, model and style from the vehicle catalog.
